摄像头画面、告警和运行概况: Camera view, alerts and runtime overview
浏览快照、回放录像和清理历史事件: Browse snapshots, play clips and manage event history
在画面上绘制区域、进出线和地面标定: Draw regions, crossing lines and ground calibration on the camera view
地面坐标、轨迹、区域统计和设备位置: Ground coordinates, trails, zone statistics and device location
检测能力、视频、显示、定位和事件策略: Detection, video, display, localization and event policies
链路指标、事件统计和配置信息: Pipeline metrics, event statistics and configuration
设备处于待机省电状态: The device is in power-saving standby
点选区域或线后可拖动顶点；画多边形至少 3 点，地面标定固定 4 点。: Select a region or line to drag vertices. Polygons require at least 3 points; ground calibration requires exactly 4.
选择一个区域、线或地面区域进行编辑。: Select a region, line or ground zone to edit.
定位超时，请检查定位来源和网络: Location timed out. Check the location sources and network.
请先在「设置 > 地面定位」中开启自动获取设备经纬度: Enable automatic device location in Settings > Ground localization first.
设备名称、功耗模式和应用偏好。: Device name, power mode and application preferences.
检测功能开关和事件声音。区域绑定在“区域”页面完成。: Detection switches and event audio. Bind features to regions on the Regions page.
摄像头参数、模型路径和热点图统计。模型或摄像头改动通常需要重启。: Camera parameters, model paths and activity statistics. Camera or model changes usually require a restart.
这些开关影响 OSD、快照、录像以及 Web 预览。: These switches affect the OSD, snapshots, clips and Web preview.
在 APP/Web 画面上显示活动热图: Show the activity heatmap in the APP and Web view
在监控画面角落叠加地面定位图: Overlay the ground map in a camera-view corner
地面标定在“区域”页面绘制；地面区域告警参数在“鸟瞰”页面编辑。: Draw ground calibration on the Regions page; edit ground-zone alerts on the Bird's-eye page.
需要至少一个已绑定的地面标定区域: Requires at least one bound ground-calibration region
Wi-Fi / IP / 手动来源按顺序尝试: Try Wi-Fi, IP and manual sources in order
告警去抖、冷却、保留策略和录像时长。: Alert debounce, cooldown, retention policy and clip duration.
完整配置会先由后端校验，再原子写盘并热加载。保存前请确认格式。: The backend validates the complete configuration, writes it atomically and hot-reloads it. Verify the format before saving.
摄像头已关闭，Web 与事件查询仍可用: Camera is off; Web and event browsing remain available
关闭摄像头进入待机？待机期间不检测、不告警、不录像。: Turn off the camera and enter standby? Detection, alerts and recording stop in standby.
关闭摄像头进入待机？: Turn off the camera and enter standby?
摄像头已关闭，设备进入待机: Camera turned off; device is in standby
清零所有越线计数？历史 counts.jsonl 不受影响。: Reset all line counts? Historical counts.jsonl data is unaffected.
区域修改尚未保存，刷新会丢弃这些修改。继续刷新？: Region changes are unsaved and will be lost. Continue refreshing?
至少一个匹配用途的区域: at least one region with a compatible role
至少保留一种定位方式；不需要设备经纬度请关闭自动定位: Keep at least one localization source, or disable automatic localization if coordinates are not needed.
纬度范围 -90～90，经度范围 -180～180，且需要同时填写: Latitude must be within -90 to 90 and longitude within -180 to 180; both are required.
区域修改尚未保存，重新载入完整配置会丢弃这些修改。继续？: Unsaved region changes will be lost. Reload the full configuration?
配置必须是 JSON 对象: Configuration must be a JSON object
校验并保存完整配置？区域、模型和摄像头配置都可能因此改变。: Validate and save the complete configuration? Regions, models and camera settings may change.
设备处于待机。先打开摄像头，才能加载区域编辑底图。: The device is in standby. Turn on the camera to load the region editor image.
当前没有可用画面，正在等待摄像头画面…: No image is available; waiting for the camera…
还没有区域或线，点击上方工具开始绘制。: No regions or lines yet. Use the tools above to draw one.
不影响地面定位总开关: Does not affect the localization master switch
关闭时进入只记一条信息事件: When off, entries generate an info event only
形状可在左侧画面拖动顶点。: Drag vertices in the image to edit the shape.
形状可在左侧画面拖动顶点，定位系统会按地面标定换算成米。: Drag vertices in the image; localization converts them to meters using ground calibration.
线按 p1 → p2 定向；只在“人数统计”启用且绑定后参与计数。: The line direction is p1 → p2. Counting applies only when People counting is enabled and bound.
矩形模式点四个地面角；多点模式可把额外测量点换算到同一坐标系内。: In rectangle mode click four ground corners. Multi-point mode can include additional measured correspondences.
当前用途没有可绑定的功能。: No bindable features for this role.
最多可创建 12 个区域（含地面标定和忽略区）。同一功能可以绑定多个区域；定位只: Up to 12 regions can be created, including ground calibration and ignore regions. A feature can be bound to multiple regions; localization can use only one ground-calibration region. Click Save regions when done.
清空活动热图？已统计的人/车活动会全部清零。: Clear the activity heatmap? All recorded person and vehicle activity will be erased.
热图样本太少，继续统计后再试: Not enough heatmap data yet; collect more activity and try again.
没有找到足够集中的热点，继续统计后再试: No sufficiently concentrated hotspot was found; collect more activity and try again.
清零所有地面区域的累计次数和停留时间？: Reset visit counts and dwell times for all ground zones?
已新建地面区域，请检查坐标、告警参数并保存: Ground zone created. Review its coordinates and alert settings, then save.
请检查后绑定功能并保存: Review them, bind features and save.
已创建，可在右侧修改属性并绑定功能。: Created. Edit properties and feature bindings on the right.
画区域：在画面上依次点击顶点，至少 3 点后点“完成”。: Draw region: click vertices in order, add at least 3 points, then select Finish.
画进出线：点击起点和终点，箭头指向 IN 一侧。: Draw crossing line: click the start and end points. The arrow points toward the IN side.
画地面标定：依次点击地面已知矩形的四个角。: Ground calibration: click the four corners of a known ground rectangle.
画地面区域：在画面上点击顶点，至少 3 点后点“完成”。: Draw ground zone: click vertices, add at least 3 points, then select Finish.
在画面上点击一个新的标定点位置。: Click the location of a new calibration point.
在画面上点击一个检查点位置。: Click the location of a check point.
请先完成或取消正在画的形状: Finish or cancel the shape being drawn first
请点击线的起点和终点: Click the start and end of the line
边自相交，请按顺时针或逆时针依次点击: Edges intersect. Click vertices clockwise or counterclockwise.
地面标定必须正好 4 个点，请重新画一个四边形: Ground calibration requires exactly 4 points. Draw a quadrilateral again.
区域、进出线和地面区域已保存: Regions, crossing lines and ground zones saved
检测并显示 COCO 80 类物体: Detect and display the 80 COCO object classes
有人进入警戒区时告警: Alert when a person enters a protected area
识别人员跌倒姿态: Recognize a person in a fallen pose
目标跨越围栏线时告警: Alert when a target crosses the fence line
目标在区域停留过久时告警: Alert when a target stays in an area too long
地面坐标、轨迹和鸟瞰图: Ground coordinates, trails and a bird's-eye view
事件确认后播放对应等级的声音: Play the corresponding alert sound after confirmation
在左侧画面拖动顶点调整形状；需要直接输入米制坐标时切换坐标来源。: Drag vertices on the image to edit the shape; switch the coordinate source to enter metric coordinates directly.
切换为地面标定会取消告警区域的绑定。继续？: Switching to ground calibration removes alarm-region bindings. Continue?
已切换为地面标定，原告警区域绑定已取消: Switched to ground calibration; the previous alarm-region bindings were removed.
停留时间必须是非负数字: Dwell time must be a non-negative number.
实际宽度和纵深必须大于 0: Real width and depth must be greater than zero.
地面区域至少需要 3 个点: A ground zone needs at least 3 points.
摄像头画面有偏移，区域已按自动跟随后的位置显示；保存后以当前画面为准。: The camera view shifted; regions are shown at the automatically adjusted positions. Saving uses the current view as the reference.
已切换区域用途并取消地面定位绑定，可在功能绑定中重新选择其它功能: Region role changed and ground-localization binding removed; choose another feature binding if needed.
没有可用的地面标定，无法转换成米制坐标；请先完成地面标定: No usable ground calibration; finish ground calibration before converting to metric coordinates.
地面定位只能使用一个地面标定区域: Ground localization can use only one calibration region.
删除这条事件及其快照、录像？: Delete this event with its snapshot and clip?
只删除这条事件的录像，保留记录和快照？: Delete only this event clip and keep the record and snapshot?
